title: biopore
intro:
A single class of biopores.
  < component (density density )
                    (height start height start )
                    (height end height end )
                    (diameter diameter ) >
    density: number component (see chapter 59)
     Biopore density [cm−2 ] as a function of ’x’ [cm].
    height start: number [cm]
     Parameter
     Biopores starts at this depth (a negative number).
    height end : number [cm]
     Parameter
     Biopores ends at this depth (a negative number).
    diameter : number [cm]
     Parameter
     Biopore diameter.

Log Variables
    S : number [cm3 /cm3 /h] soil cells
     Total stream from matrix domain to biopore.
    J : submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
     Solute flux between cells.
        <   name value ...      >    Log Variables

        – value: number [g/cm2 /h] soil edges
          Value for chemical.
        – name: string (see section 4.1.5)
          Name of chemical.

    q: number [cm/h] soil edges
     Water flow in this biopore class.
    S chem: submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
     Matrix to biopore term for solutes.
        <   name value ...      >    Log Variables

          – value: number [g/cm3 /h] soil cells
            Value for chemical.
          – name: string (see section 4.1.5)
            Name of chemical.

       M2B : number [cm3 /cm3 /h] soil cells
        Strem from matrix domain to biopore. Never negative.

       B2M : number [cm3 /cm3 /h] soil cells
        Stream from biopore to matrix domain. Never negative.

       infiltration: number [cm/h]
        Surface infiltration.

       solute infiltration: submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
        Rate of solute infiltration through surface.
          <    name value      >    Log Variables

          – value: number [g/cm2 /h]
            Value for chemical.
          – name: string (see section 4.1.5)
            Name of chemical.

sections.desc: Biopores that ends in the matrix.

< matrix (solute)

attrs.name: solute
attrs.doc:
Chemical concentration in biopore intervals.
       <    name value ...    >

attrs.name: – name
attrs.doc: Name of chemical.

attrs.name: – value
attrs.doc: Value for chemical.

attrs.name: debug
attrs.doc: Debug level. Increase value to get more debug message.

attrs.name: xplus
attrs.doc:
Right side of each biopore interval. Water and chemical content is tracked
    individually for each interval. By default, use intervals as specified by the
    geometry.

attrs.name: K wall relative
attrs.doc: Relative conductivity of biopore wall compared to matrix.

attrs.name: h bottom
attrs.doc: Pressure at the bottom of the biopores in each interval.

attrs.name: max iterations
attrs.doc: Maximum number of iterations when seeking convergence.

attrs.name: max absolute difference
attrs.doc: Maximum absolute difference in biopore content for convergence.

attrs.name: max relative difference
attrs.doc: Maximum relative difference in biopore content for convergence.

attrs.name: allow upward flow
attrs.doc:
Allow water to enter from saturated soil at the bottom of the biopore. And
        leave in unsaturated soil above.

attrs.name: water
attrs.doc: Water content.

attrs.name: Theta
attrs.doc: Water content in this biopore class.

attrs.name: M
attrs.doc:
Chemical content in soil cells.
          <    name value ...     >     Log Variables
          – value: number [g/cm3 ] soil cells
            Value for chemical.
          – name: string (see section 4.1.5)
            Name of chemical.

attrs.name: iterations
attrs.doc: Number of iterations used for finding a solution.

attrs.name: h3 soil
attrs.doc: Pressure suggested by the soil for each interval.

attrs.name: z3 lowest
attrs.doc:
Depth of lowest unsaturated cell in each interval. Water may not enter the
        macropore below this depth.

sections.text:
Biopores that ends in the matrix.
  < matrix (solute)
               (debug 0)
               (xplus xplus ...)
               (K wall relative K wall relative )
               (h bottom h bottom ...)
               (max iterations 50)
               (max absolute difference 0.02 [cm])
               (max relative difference 0.001 [])
               (allow upward flow true)
               ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 20.
               (density density )
               (height start height start )
               (height end height end )
               (diameter diameter ) >

   solute: submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
    Submodel (default: an empty sequence)
    Chemical concentration in biopore intervals.
       <    name value ...    >

       – name: string (see section 4.1.5)
         Optional state variable
         Name of chemical.
       – value: number [g] sequence
         Optional state variable
         Value for chemical.

   debug: integer
    Parameter (default 0)
    Debug level. Increase value to get more debug message.

   xplus: number [cm] sequence
    Optional parameter
    Right side of each biopore interval. Water and chemical content is tracked
    individually for each interval. By default, use intervals as specified by the
    geometry.

   K wall relative: number (dimensionless)
    Parameter
    Relative conductivity of biopore wall compared to matrix.

   h bottom: number [cm] sequence
    Optional state variable
    Pressure at the bottom of the biopores in each interval.

   max iterations: integer
    Parameter (default 50)
    Maximum number of iterations when seeking convergence.

   max absolute difference: number [cm]
    Parameter (default 0.02)
    Maximum absolute difference in biopore content for convergence.

       max relative difference: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 0.001)
        Maximum relative difference in biopore content for convergence.

       allow upward flow : boolean (see section 4.1.2)
        Parameter (default true)
        Allow water to enter from saturated soil at the bottom of the biopore. And
        leave in unsaturated soil above.

Log Variables
       water : number [cm3 ]
        Water content.
       Theta: number [cm3 /cm3 ] soil cells
        Water content in this biopore class.
       M : submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
        Chemical content in soil cells.
          <    name value ...     >     Log Variables

          – value: number [g/cm3 ] soil cells
            Value for chemical.
          – name: string (see section 4.1.5)
            Name of chemical.

       iterations: integer
        Number of iterations used for finding a solution.
       h3 soil : number [cm] sequence
        Pressure suggested by the soil for each interval.
       z3 lowest: number [cm] sequence
        Depth of lowest unsaturated cell in each interval. Water may not enter the
        macropore below this depth.
